title: Customer Groups
description: Segment customers for pricing and promotions.

help.title: About Customer Groups
help.overview: Customer groups segment buyers, for example retail and wholesale, so pricing rules can give each group its own prices. A customer can belong to several groups.

sections.title: Membership
sections.body: Membership is staff-only, because it changes what customers pay.
items: Add member and remove member manage one record per customer in the group; a customer cannot be added twice.
The member count shown on the group follows those records.
Set default marks one group as the company default and clears the previous one. It does not add anyone by itself.

sections.title: How pricing reads groups
items: A pricing rule with no groups applies to every cart. A rule that lists groups applies only when the signed-in customer is in one of them.
Guest carts belong to no group.
Discount codes do not check groups when they are applied.

sections.title: Deleting
items: Deleting a group is a soft delete and removes its memberships with it. Restoring brings those memberships back, except for customers re-added since.
